title: Bound Tauri backend process output capture
summary: Bound physical-line retention and diagnostic emission while continuously draining Tauri-managed backend stdout and stderr.
reason: Remediate P2 AUDIT-FIND-W09-004. BufRead::lines allocated and logged arbitrarily large physical lines from the managed backend process.
behavior_before: Backend stdout and stderr used BufRead::lines, so an unterminated or flooding stream could allocate an arbitrary physical line and emit unbounded diagnostic output.
behavior_after: Backend pipes are incrementally drained with fixed per-line retention, overflow counters, bounded diagnostic previews, and time-limited aggregate suppression summaries while bootstrap discovery remains bounded and lossless for valid payloads within the documented limit.
tests_added: Multi-megabyte unterminated physical lines retain only the configured byte budget and report discarded bytes.
Flooding output keeps draining while diagnostic previews remain bounded and suppression counters remain content-free.
Bootstrap parsing accepts a valid payload split across incremental reader buffers.
manual_validation: Focused Rust adversarial tests passed for a three-MiB unterminated physical line, split-buffer bootstrap payload, and 100,000-line flood with bounded previews and content-free counters.
cargo fmt --all --check, cargo test --locked --lib, and cargo check --release --locked passed; 66 Rust tests passed without release warnings.
Canonical dev-mode Tauri launch/close smoke passed in 29.1 seconds and verified cleanup of shell PID 41612 and backend PID 59344.
Generated project index, dependency graph, feature file map, feature cards, and five targeted summaries were refreshed; project-index and feature-map check modes passed.
Summary-integrity, feature-card, and risky-registry tooling passed: 30 tests and 70 subtests.
Architecture guardrails and risky-file registry passed; god-file debt remained at the accepted baseline of 0 errors and 51 warnings.
Summary freshness reported only five unrelated baseline stale summaries after this packet refreshed backend_process/tests.rs.

The dependency-boundary check retained the unrelated AUDIT-FIND-DEP-001 package-cycle baseline, and the active-document reference check reported unrelated DOC005 in docs/reviews/comprehensive-production-audit-2026-07-19/evidence/BASELINE.md.
Strict worktree coverage passed: 1153 change packets valid.
rollback_plan: Revert the bounded reader, output limiter, regression tests, lifecycle documentation, generated artifacts, and this packet together. Do not restore BufRead::lines on child-controlled streams.
notes: This batch changes only shell-side child-process output availability and diagnostics. It does not alter backend media policy or close-readiness semantics, so representative real-media validation is not required.
